top_signals.title: Space Force picks two companies to build new ‘space-to-space’ satellites by 2028
top_signals.summary: The Pentagon announced Northrop Grumman and True Anomaly will build new ISR satellites in space, after admitting the U.S. already has weapons in orbit.
